summary_en: This study tests toripalimab given with cisplatin and docetaxel (called PDT) as induction therapy for locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma in patients who are CPS-positive. The medicines are given by intravenous infusion once every 21 days, for up to 3 cycles. The study is a Phase 2 trial that measures safety and tolerability.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa toripalimab junto con cisplatino y docetaxel (llamado PDT) como terapia de inducción para el carcinoma de células escamosas de cabeza y cuello localmente avanzado en pacientes con CPS positivo. Los medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa una vez cada 21 días, hasta 3 ciclos. El estudio es de Fase 2 y mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad.
who_for: New diagnosis of confirmed squamous cell carcinoma of listed head and neck sites.
Stage III or non-metastatic stage IV disease (stage II or III for HPV-associated oropharynx).
Investigator judges the person a candidate for induction systemic therapy.
ECOG performance status of 1 or less and life expectancy over 12 weeks.
not_for: Proven distant metastases below the clavicle.
Diagnosis of EBV-associated nasopharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma.
Prior head or neck radiotherapy that prevents curative-intent radiation.
Pre-existing peripheral neuropathy grade 2 or higher.
Active second malignancy as defined by the investigator, or pregnancy or breastfeeding.
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
